item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Bottle Turns Slowly in Place

turns.text: Animate this bottle turning slowly in place on the table, just a gentle quarter turn. Keep the camera still. Make it 6 seconds, square, no sound.

item.tests: Tests actual product rotation from a source photo rather than a camera orbit, with stable product geometry and surroundings.

answer_sheet.Source product: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg.
answer_sheet.Motion: A slow, gentle quarter turn of the bottle in place; rotation direction is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and setting: Keep it photorealistic, retaining the wooden table and original surroundings with a stationary camera.

must_haves: The matte black insulated bottle from the attachment remains recognizable throughout.
The bottle visibly turns slowly through roughly a quarter turn, rather than merely sliding or enlarging.
The bottle stays upright on the table without melting, bending or changing its proportions.
The camera and wooden table remain stationary.
The output is a square, silent video lasting approximately 6 seconds.

turns.text: Could you animate the bottle in this pic so it turns slowly in place on the table? I've had this little animation in mind for a while and am curious to see it come to life. What I mean is just a gentle quarter turn, with the video being 6 seconds long and square. I always feel like I over-explain these things because I'm worried I haven't described what I'm picturing clearly enough. Please keep the camera still and make it with no sound.

style.prompt: Square 1:1 composition matching the supplied image. Locked-off camera, completely stationary throughout. The black bottle gently and slowly rotates exactly one quarter turn (90 degrees) around its own vertical axis over six seconds, turning in place on the wooden table. Its base remains planted at the same spot without sliding, tilting or lifting. Preserve the bottle's shape, matte black finish, cap and handle, original scale, table, background, lighting and framing. Only the bottle rotates; everything else remains still. Smooth subtle natural motion. No sound, no added text.
